newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico February coffee exports hit month record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico February coffee exports hit month record.

text.p: Mexico exported 883,725 60-kg bags of coffee in February compared to the 744,586 bags sent abroad in the same month a year earlier, the Mexican Coffee Council said in a reported obtained by Reuters.

The council, the government umbrella organisation covering the entire coffee sector, said the export figure represented a 18.7 percent rise from February 1996. The new figure is an all-time monthly record for exports from Mexico.

In the first five months of the 1996-1997 cycle, the council said Mexico exported 2,634,104 bags of coffee, compared to the 2,309,881 bags in the same reference period from the 1995-1996 crop -- a 14 percent rise.
No reason was given for the record export figure, although it is well known that Mexican exporters have been taking advantage of this year's spike in prices.
A full breakdown of Mexican exports follows in table form. Figures are for 60-kg bags.
